description: An outpatient infusion clinic manager must finalize next week's on-call nurse assignment for a Saturday biologic infusion session, with input from the lead pharmacist and the scheduling coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The clinic will run a Saturday infusion session next week for one high-priority biologic patient.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final on-call staffing decision for that session.
shared_context.S3: The session needs exactly one on-call RN assigned before the weekly schedule is locked.
shared_context.S4: Two internal RNs are available on the draft roster: Nurse Patel and Nurse Greene.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena confirms the assignment, the weekly operations huddle includes a quick round for pharmacy and scheduling issues that could affect the session.

PF1.text: This patient's biologic was changed last month, and only Nurse Greene has current in-service signoff in the medication administration record for that exact drug; without that signoff, the RN cannot administer it under clinic policy.

PF2.text: Nurse Greene already told scheduling she can take the Saturday session only if it ends by 1:00 p.m. because she starts a pre-approved caregiving leave block that afternoon.

acceptance_conditions: The on-call RN must be Nurse Greene.
The session must be scheduled to end no later than 13:00.
A commitment must be logged to book the patient into an early slot so the infusion can finish by 13:00.
A backup coverage commitment must be logged in case the session runs long.
The medication-specific signoff fact must be explicitly credited, justified, and revealed.

content_checks.C3: any((c['type'] == 'early_slot_booking' and c['target'] == 'Saturday infusion patient') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'backup_coverage' and c['target'] == 'Saturday session') for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: (('PF1' in credited_facts) and ('PF1' in justification_fact_ids) and ('PF1' in revealed)) == True

decisive_facts.why: PF1 changes which nurse can legally administer the biologic under clinic policy, making Nurse Greene the only acceptable assignment instead of either rostered RN.
PF2 sets a hard 13:00 end time for Nurse Greene's availability, which changes the schedule cutoff and requires both an early patient slot and a backup coverage plan if the session runs long.
